subtitle.zh: 让三国权谋，成为可以亲手落子的世界。
subtitle.en: A Three Kingdoms world where every decision is yours.

summary.zh: 三国权谋策略 RPG。在确定性规则之上，让 AI NPC 对话、人物关系与多系统决策共同推动一局游戏。
summary.en: A strategy RPG combining deterministic systems with AI NPC dialogue, character relationships and turn-based decisions.

role.zh: 项目负责人 · 游戏策划 · 前端制作

coverAlt.zh: 《乱世执棋》大地图与城池信息界面，来自本人作品集
coverAlt.en: Luanshi Zhiqi world map and city interface, from the author's portfolio

results.zh: 2026 腾讯云黑客松华南赛区第九名¹
results.en: 9th, South China region, 2026 Tencent Cloud Hackathon¹

paragraphs.zh: 在 20 天的比赛周期里，3 人团队完成了能够线上游玩的三国策略游戏。我担任项目负责人，负责核心玩法策划、主要前端交互、协作推进与线下路演。
paragraphs.en: Our three-person team delivered an online strategy game within 20 days. I led the project, designed its core gameplay, implemented the main frontend interactions and presented the game on site.

paragraphs.zh: ¹ 华南赛区第九名来自本人简历和作品集记录；官方获奖证明待补充。试玩入口与代码仓库均来自原始简历。
paragraphs.en: ¹ The regional ranking is recorded in my resume and portfolio; official award documentation is pending. The play and repository links are taken from the source resume.

title.zh: 让每条指令，都回到同一个战局。
title.en: Connect every order to the same world.

paragraphs.zh: 围绕三国大地图，组织城池、内政、军事、调兵、谋略、外交、亲信、人物与任命。玩家在城池信息与人物关系之间判断优先级，再通过指令队列与回合结算观察结果。
paragraphs.en: Cities, domestic affairs, military orders, diplomacy, intrigue and appointments share a single strategic map. Players assess cities and relationships, choose priorities, queue orders and inspect their consequences at turn resolution.

paragraphs.zh: 设计重点不是独立菜单的数量，而是让不同系统的信息能够支持下一次选择：资源决定行动空间，人物关系影响交涉，回合结算把行动转换成可读取的反馈。
paragraphs.en: The design focus is how each system informs the next decision: resources constrain options, relationships shape negotiation, and turn resolution makes outcomes legible.

title.zh: AI 负责表达，规则承接后果。

paragraphs.zh: 我参与历史 NPC 自由对话、人物关系与状态流转体验的设计，并制作对应的前端交互。对话负责承载人物表达；城池、指令与回合等确定性系统承接游戏行为。
paragraphs.en: I helped design historical NPC conversations, relationship interactions and state transitions, and built their frontend. Dialogue carries character expression while the map, order queue and turn systems structure gameplay.

paragraphs.zh: 这里呈现的是我参与的体验设计与界面工作。登录注册、角色创建、云端存档和后端服务由队友负责，不计入个人独立实现成果。
paragraphs.en: My contribution is the experience design and interface implementation. Teammates owned authentication, character creation, cloud saves and backend services.

title.zh: 一人多职，也把边界说清楚。

paragraphs.zh: 本人负责：玩法方向与策划案筹备、核心系统设计、大地图与城池信息界面、回合结算与指令队列交互、AI NPC 对话前端，以及团队方向推进和路演。
paragraphs.en: My work: gameplay direction, design preparation, core systems, map and city interfaces, turn resolution and order queues, NPC conversation UI, team coordination and presentation.

paragraphs.zh: 队友负责：后端制作、登录与云端存档、美术调整和新手教程。团队共同完成：整合、现场展示与用户试玩。
paragraphs.en: Teammates: backend, authentication and cloud saves, art adjustments and onboarding. Shared work: integration, live demonstration and player demos.

title.zh: 短周期里的优先级：完成一局。
title.en: A short deadline demands a complete loop.

paragraphs.zh: 通过自然语言与 AI 持续迭代需求，把策划推演落实到前端界面与逻辑调试。20 天交付的重点是让玩家走完核心流程，并让现场展示能清楚呈现核心玩法。
paragraphs.en: I used natural-language collaboration with AI to iterate requirements, frontend interfaces and logic. The priority was a complete playable loop that could be demonstrated clearly within the competition deadline.

paragraphs.zh: 下一步复盘聚焦：补充可追溯的版本记录、用户反馈与正式演示视频。现有资料没有完整测试样本，不将现场试玩包装为已验证的留存或平衡结果。
paragraphs.en: Next: document versions, player feedback and a formal demo video. Existing materials do not contain a complete test dataset, so live demos are not presented as retention or balance validation.
